resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com describe a crow's nest and tent cabin. The Oregon lookouts site describes a 10x12 log dwelling with a shake roof, 50 feet up in a tree. The story gives the Oregon site's account as its own and notes the difference.

The register and firelookout.com name the Douglas FPA. The Oregon lookouts site files the entry under Umpqua National Forest, which may refer to the land rather than the administrator. The story names the Douglas FPA as the register's administrator.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out: 30 ft tower (9.1 m), Douglas FPA, FFLOS US 937, gone. Source 4 is a different Windy Camp (Mt. Hood NF, Hood River County, 'Abandoned 1940s'); it is mentioned in the story only to prevent confusion. The Oregon lookouts page has no removal date for this tower, so 'gone by 1959' rests on the register and firelookout.com. No staffing found in the sources read. No photo with a usable image URL was retrieved.
